items.title: 3 Utility Stocks Riding Data Center Power Demand
items.summary: Data centers are racing to keep up with AI demand, yet the real bottleneck is something far less glamorous than chips: electricity. That tension between digital ambition and physical grid constraints is where potential opportunity emerges for investors watching power infrastructure, grid owners, and utilities exposed to this theme. This article walks through three stocks from our screener that sit close to this fault line and explains how the recent news could matter for each one. The three...

items.title: NRG Energy Reports Soon: How Has The Stock Reacted To Past Earnings?
items.summary: NRG Energy (NYSE:NRG) is scheduled to report its earnings on Monday, November 9, 2026. The company has a market value of about $17.0 billion. Over the last twelve months it generated $33.1 billion in revenue and $2.1 billion in operating profit, with net income of $849 million.
